attributes.action: A Fairer Funding Deal for Gloucestershire
attributes.additional_details:
We are urging the Government to do five things:

•	Give Gloucestershire a fair funding settlement.
•	End the long-standing injustice in schools and SEND funding.
•	Invest properly in Gloucestershire’s roads.
•	Pay the costs of Local Government Reorganisation.
•	Act now on social care and provide meaningful reform so no-one is left behind.       

Add your name today and join residents, businesses and community groups across Gloucestershire in calling for a fair deal.
attributes.background: Despite Gloucestershire County Council working hard to deliver vital services, we face tough choices due to under-funding. Our children get less per pupil than most other councils, our roads need investment and social care is under relentless pressure. Gloucestershire deserves Fairer Funding now!

rejection.details:
We can’t accept petitions that call for action at a local level.

You could ask your MP to take action on your concerns about this issue, including by asking them to present a public (paper) petition about this.

You can find contact details for your local MP here: https://members.parliament.uk/FindYourMP

And you can find out how to ask your MP to present a public (paper) petition here: https://www.parliament.uk/get-involved/sign-a-petition/paper-petitions/

You could also raise your issue with a local councillor who represents you. You can use this page to find out who your local councillors are, and how to contact them: https://www.gov.uk/find-your-local-councillors
